ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 revision, effective January 1, 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities (Jointly issued by PBOC and SAMR as Order No. 3, effective November 1, 2024); State Administration for Market Regulation Implementing Regulations for Enterprise Name Registration (2020); Proceeds of Crime Ordinance (Cap. 405) and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Amendment) Ordinance applicable to Hong Kong intermediate entities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Certificate of Incorporation of the Hong Kong Holding Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization under the Mainland-HK Arrangement: (1) notarization by a Hong Kong notary public; (2) authentication by China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited; (3) transmission to the PRC Ministry of Justice. No Hague Apostille applies because the destination is within China.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Continuing Existence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization under the Mainland-HK Arrangement: (1) notarization by a Hong Kong notary public; (2) authentication by China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited; (3) legalization for SAMR acceptance. Hague Apostille is not applicable to intra-China document flows.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney for WFOE Registration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Holding Company (Board of Directors)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hong Kong notary public notarization followed by authentication through China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited and PRC Ministry of Justice recordal; no apostille because both parties are within the same sovereign.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Articles of Association (Memorandum and Articles of the Hong Kong Holding Company)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route: notarized copy certified by Hong Kong notary public, then authenticated by China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited for use in Mainland China; apostille is not used for intra-country transfers.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter (Certified Credit and Account Standing Letter)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Principal commercial bank of the Hong Kong Holding Company in Hong Kong (e.g., HSBC or Standard Chartered, H.K. branch)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank letter must be notarized by a Hong Kong notary public for signatory authenticity and then legalized through China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited; no Hague Apostille as this is a Mainland-HK internal authentication matter.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department (Business Registration Office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy notarized by a Hong Kong notary public, then authenticated by China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited, and forwarded to SAMR-submitting counsel; apostille not applicable between Mainland and HKSAR.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners and authorized signatories must undergo enhanced due diligence against international and domestic sanctions lists, including OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council sanctions lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the PRC Ministry of Public Security's List of Terrorists. With respect to politically exposed persons (PEPs), mandatory screening must cover current and former senior foreign officials, domestic senior officials, and persons entrusted with prominent public functions in Hong Kong, applying a risk-based approach requiring senior management approval before onboarding any PEP. The protocol further mandates continuous periodic re-screening every 12 months and transaction monitoring against unusual patterns consistent with the risk tier of 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced', as reflected in the entity's banking and AML classification.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_not: This bundle exceeds the minimum five instruments required and fully distinguishes the parallel authentication paths: Hague Apostille is used for documents originating in an Apostille Convention state (e.g., the United States, United Kingdom, mainland China itself when exporting documents to another contracting country), whereas Consular Legalization applies to documents from non-member states or internal Mainland-HK transfers. They are never chained sequentially.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) - Enterprise Name Self-Service Declaration and Registration System (企业名称自主申报系统, official English interface as 'Enterprise Name Independent Application System')
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the Registration of Enterprise Names Implementation Measures (SAMR 2020), a WFOE's name must be in standard Chinese characters and consist of four tiers in the fixed order: (1) administrative division (e.g., 'Shanghai'); (2) trade name; (3) industry or business description (e.g., 'Construction Machinery Import & Export Trading'); and (4) organizational form ('Limited Liability Company'). A foreign parent company's name may be transliterated into Chinese characters for the trade-name portion, and pinyin alone is insufficient. English-only names are not accepted for the registered Chinese name; a parallel English name may be used for banking and contracts but does not replace the statutory Chinese name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of an enterprise name application, the applicant or its legal counsel may file an administrative reconsideration petition with the higher-level SAMR authority within 60 days of the rejection notice, setting out the legal grounds and supplementary evidence to rebut the rejection reason. If the reconsideration decision is adverse or the authority fails to decide within 60 days, the applicant may initiate an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court within 6 months from the date of the reconsideration decision or the expiry of the statutory decision period. The petition must identify the specific name applicant, the rejected name string, the administrative decision reference number, and all gaps cited in the rejection. A de novo application with a modified trade name may also be filed immediately without waiting for the appeal, but this does not toll the appeal deadline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is categorically rejected for a China WFOE engaged in wholesale trading of used construction machinery. Market regulation authorities require a fixed, physical business premises capable of accommodating the enterprise's actual operations and meet-and-greet facilities; the local tax bureau requires a verifiable lease and on-site records for issuing VAT invoices; and commercial banks require a physical inspection for corporate account opening, especially for a Medium_Risk_Enhanced import/export entity. The registered address must match the lease, the actual place of business, and the one-per-address rule (one office per registered address except for 'one address, multi-license' pilot schemes which do not apply to used machinery trading).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Likelihood of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the municipal market supervision administration or tax authorities is 40% within the first two years after registration. Checklist for inspection readiness: (1) a valid lease agreement in the company's name covering the full registered address; (2) visible company signage at the entrance; (3) on-site desks, computers, and file cabinets; (4) at least one staff member present during working hours; (5) availability of statutory books, invoices, and customs declarations; (6) electricity/internet utility bills in the enterprise's name; (7) consistency of the registered address with the business license, bank account, and customs declaration address. If a 'red flag' is triggered (e.g., low volume for the sector or VAT refund anomalies lag, the inspection probability rises to 65%).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory official fee is levied by SAMR for name reservation or company registration; this is a government-taxpayer zero-fee item.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National Tax Administration (stamp duty on business license and capital book)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under PRC Stamp Duty Law; license and authority certificates are taxed at RMB 5 per copy (reduced to zero for certain small enterprises, but budgeted conservatively).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate seal carvings (company chop, finance chop, legal representative chop, invoice chop)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized seal engraving service provider registered with the public security bureau
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark rate in first-tier Chinese cities; non-official commercial fee.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Hong Kong notary public / foreign-related law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of HK$1,500–3,000 per instrument; quoted for six instruments plus incidental correspondence.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Authentication by China Legal Service (Hong Kong) Limited
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Tariff schedule promulgated by the PRC Ministry of Justice for legal document authentication between Mainland and HKSAR; fixed per-document fee.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of Hong Kong documents into Chinese
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of RMB 200–350 per 1,000 Chinese characters; quoted for a 12-page bundle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mainland corporate law firm retainer for WFOE incorporation filing and bank account liaison
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard WFOE setup package in a tier-1 city, excluding capital verification or customs registration support.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank's official tariff schedule; includes account opening, online banking token, and safekeeping card fee.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing with Customs (foreign trade operator registration) and electronic port ICP card
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Customs administrative registration is free; the card production fee and electronic port software service fee are charged by the authorized service provider.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) of the Laws of Hong Kong, specifically sections 67 (formation), 68 (registration), 112 (constitutional documents), 474 (company secretary qualification), and sections 503-504 (written resolutions); also Business Registration Ordinance (Cap. 310).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Registry, Hong Kong (e-Registry)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Form NNC1 (Application for Incorporation of a Private Company Limited by Shares) together with the Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. Under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), a private company limited by shares may be incorporated with a nominal share capital of one share of HK$1.00. No escrow, blocked account, or minimum paid-up capital is required for formation. The subscriber must execute a declaration that no further capital is required prior to commencing business; if the company engages in banking, insurance, or regulated activities, additional sectoral capital rules under the relevant licensing statutes may apply, but those are not triggered by the target wholesale trading business.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF CN WFOE LIMITED (the 'Company'). Adopted by written resolution pursuant to section 503 of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) and the Company's Articles of Association. RESOLVED, by unanimous consent of the sole director(s) or by a simple majority of directors present and voting, as follows: 1. ARTICLES: The Articles of Association submitted with the incorporation application are ratified; the directors must ensure full compliance with the Companies Ordinance and common law duties. 2. SHARE CAPITAL: The authorized share capital of the Company is fixed at HK$10,000 divided into 10,000 ordinary shares of HK$1.00 each; the initial issued capital is one ordinary share, issued and allotted to the founding shareholder, fully paid in cash; the directors are authorized to issue further shares in compliance with the ordinance and to maintain that no public offer is made. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office is established at the address specified on the incorporation form in Hong Kong; the Company Secretary is required to file any change of address with the Companies Registry within 15 days. 4. OFFICERS: The person named in the incorporation application as the first director is appointed as director; the person named as Company Secretary is appointed, and the director confirms such person meets the qualifications prescribed under section 474. 5. BANK MANDATE: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited is appointed as the principal banker; any one director or any two directors jointly acting as per the mandate are authorized to open accounts, sign cheques, execute loan documents, and operate online banking. 6. BUSINESS REGISTRATION: The directors are instructed to apply for the Business Registration Certificate under Cap. 310 within one month of incorporation, and to obtain any import/export or other licences required for the trading of used construction machinery. 7. GENERAL AUTHORITY: Each director is authorised to execute and file all documents, engage solicitors and accountants, and take all lawful steps to implement this resolution. This resolution is effective immediately and may be relied upon by third parties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the proposed company name through the Companies Registry's online search and reservation service. Provide the exact name in English and, if desired, in Chinese, together with a brief explanation of the business purpose. Obtain a certificate of name reservation if requested, or rely on the name screening in the NNC1. The Registrar will reject names that are identical to existing companies, too similar, or contrary to law. You must review the company's proposed name against the registered names index before submission. Additionally, conduct a trademark search through the Intellectual Property Department to avoid passing off. This step ensures that the final incorporation form can be filed without a name conflict, saving time and fees.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name in English (and Chinese, if any)
Articles of Association draft (optional at this stage)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, the applicant should resubmit with a different name or request a written refusal statement; a letter of appeal with justification can be filed to the Companies Registry within 21 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Form and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Form NNC1 (Incorporation Form for a Private Company Limited by Shares) and prepare the Articles of Association. The AOA must contain the company name, share structure, director powers, and any restrictions on share transfers. The form must be signed by the subscriber(s) before an authorised witness or via recognized electronic signature. After the form and AOA are completed, upload them to the e-Registry portal and pay the prescribed filing fee. The Companies Registrar will perform a substantive review to confirm compliance with Cap. 622. If any item is incomplete, the Registry will issue an enquiry notice requiring a response within 14 days; unresolved defects will lead to rejection. Once satisfied, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Copy of subscriber's passport or Hong Kong identity card
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
Letter of consent from proposed director and secretary (if not included in NNC1)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Registry's inquiry within 14 days with amended forms; if the filing is rejected due to unresolved defects, re-file with a fresh NNC1 and pay the filing fee again; administrative reconsideration or judicial review may be pursued in extreme cases.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Incorporation and Business Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Inland Revenue Department, Business Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Certificate of Incorporation, the company must apply for the Business Registration Certificate (BRC) within one month under the Business Registration Ordinance (Cap. 310). Complete Form IRBR1 (Application for Business Registration) and submit it either online or in person at the Business Registration Office. The application should include the Certificate of Incorporation, the registered office address, and particulars of the directors. The Business Registration Office will issue the BRC showing the business name and address; the registration fee and levy must be paid annually. Maintain the BRC at the registered office and display it prominently as required.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or tenancy order for the registered office
If the business name differs, a translation or explanation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the BRC application is questioned, supply a covering letter explaining the business nature and any omitted documents; if deemed late, pay the late fee under Cap. 310 and preserve the payment receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and KYC Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Hong Kong banks (e.g., HSBC, Standard Chartered, Bank of China Hong Kong) via Relationship Manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Arrange a meeting with the bank's relationship manager to open a corporate account for the used construction machinery trading business. The directors must bring the Certificate of Incorporation, BRC, AOA, the board resolution approving the bank mandate, and personal identification documents of all signatories. The bank will conduct customer due diligence, including Beneficial Ownership verification, source of funds explanation, and expected transaction volumes. As the target payment rails are wire transfers and Swift LCs, the bank may require trade finance documentation. If additional information is requested, supply it within a reasonable time; otherwise, the application may be rejected. On approval, obtain the account number and test wire instructions.
required_dossiers: Identity and address proof of directors and ultimate beneficial owners
Business plan and pro-forma invoices for the excavator exports
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines or suspends the account application, request a written reason; engage the existing relationship manager to file an updated due diligence document package; consider an alternative licensed bank or trade finance specialist; or file a complaint with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority if the bank acted unreasonably.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial and Trade Compliance Registration for Used Machinery Trading
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Trade and Industry Department (Import/Export Licensing Division) and relevant premises authorities (Buildings Department, Fire Services Department, Environmental Protection Department)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Determine whether the used construction excavators to be imported or exported are controlled goods under the Import and Export Ordinance (Cap. 60) and the Import and Export (Strategic Commodities) Regulations (Cap. 60G). For most non-strategic construction machinery, no separate import/export license is required; however, if the excavator contains high-grade hydraulic controllers or cryptographic components, an export license may be mandatory. Apply online through the Trade and Industry Department's TIDDS electronic system if needed. Concurrently, if the company will maintain physical inventory or hold machinery in a warehouse, arrange an inspection by the Buildings Department for floor loading and by the Fire Services Department for fire safety compliance; obtain the relevant certificate. If any maintenance or degreasing will be undertaken at the premises, the Environmental Protection Department may classify the operation as a non-scheduled process and require environmental registration or a waste disposal licence.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma sales and purchase contracts for the used excavators
Serial numbers, condition reports, and age certificates for the machinery
Proof of premises ownership or lease for storage
Fire insurance policy and compliance certificates
Environmental self-assessment form (if maintenance is performed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a license application is denied or suspended, obtain a formal refusal notice in writing, appeal to the Trade and Industry Department within 28 days, and simultaneously seek legal counsel to correct any export-control classification errors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Inland Revenue Department (Business Registration Office) and Trade and Industry Department (Import/Export Division)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Registration Certificate (BRC) under the Business Registration Ordinance (Cap. 310); optionally, an Import/Export Licence under the Import and Export Ordinance (Cap. 60) for controlled or strategic commodities if the used excavators fall within the schedule.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Department, Hong Kong SAR
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Exemption – Category 3 (Exempted Non-Scheduled Process); Full EIA not required for pure trading and remarketing of used machinery. If the company conducts any washing, degreasing, or mechanical repair at the premises, it may shift to Category 2 requiring an Environmental Review under the EIA Ordinance (Cap. 499) or a waste disposal licence under Cap. 354.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater discharge from the trading activity is permitted into storm drains without a discharge licence under the Water Pollution Control Ordinance (Cap. 358). Total volatile organic compounds (VOCs) emitted from any occasional cold cleaning or degreasing must remain below 500 kilograms per year; hazardous chemical waste storage must not exceed 4.5 cubic metres without an EPD registration; the company must use an EPD-licensed waste collector for disposal of oily residues, and maintain records of waste disposal for at least 3 years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The proposed storage or showroom premises must obtain a fire safety certificate under the Fire Service (Installations and Equipment) Regulations (Cap. 95) before operating; the Buildings Department may require a Certificate of Compliance (Building) or structural load certification under Buildings Ordinance (Cap. 123) if storage of machinery exceeds 1.5 kN/m²; the company must afford a safe working environment under the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance (Cap. 509), including a proper traffic management plan for forklifts and lifting equipment, and the Labour Department may require a provisional notification under the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance (Cap. 59) if any repair work is deemed industrial.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; taxpayer filing is conducted through the STA Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax Bureau) portal at www.chinatax.gov.cn and the relevant provincial Electronic Tax Bureau systems.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident investor establishing a WFOE must first complete company incorporation with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). The Business License contains the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is the sole statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration number of the WFOE. No separate TIN certificate is issued. Within 30 days of the Business License date, the WFOE's taxpayer information is automatically transmitted to the STA through the multi-license integration system, and the WFOE must file supplemental taxpayer information through the e-Tax Bureau or the local tax service hall. Required documentation includes: the SAMR Business License; the foreign investor's notarized and China-certified corporate registration documents (or apostilled equivalent); the board resolution establishing the WFOE; the memorandum/articles of association; the registered office lease or proof of address; legal representative identity documents; appointment documents for the finance officer/principal accounting personnel; and bank account opening confirmation. After verification, the STA activates the tax registration, assigns tax type attributes, determines VAT taxpayer type (small-scale or general taxpayer), and registers the entity for corporate income tax, VAT, stamp duty, urban construction tax and surcharges. If annual taxable sales are expected to exceed RMB 5,000,000, VAT general taxpayer registration is mandatory; otherwise the entity may remain a small-scale taxpayer until the threshold is exceeded. The foreign non-resident investor itself does not obtain a Chinese TIN merely by owning the WFOE; any PRC-source income payable to the non-resident is subject to withholding tax by the WFOE.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (PRC resident enterprise; the WFOE is a separate limited liability legal person subject to enterprise income tax at 25% and is not eligible for pass-through or check-the-box transparency. The Hong Kong SAR parent is treated as a non-resident shareholder, not a branch of the WFOE.)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (no check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election exists under PRC tax law; entity-level taxation is mandatory for a WFOE. The only related elective measure is the VAT small-scale/general taxpayer status election below the statutory turnover threshold, which is not an entity classification election.)

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC VAT system (formerly the Provisional Regulations on Value-Added Tax; now administered under the PRC VAT Law and implementing rules by the State Taxation Administration).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY. No turnover threshold applies to the basic tax registration of an incorporated entity: formation as a WFOE triggers automatic tax registration. For VAT classification, annual taxable sales not exceeding RMB 5,000,000 qualify as small-scale taxpayer status; once annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000, the WFOE must register as a VAT general taxpayer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices must be issued through the STA-controlled e-invoicing system. The fully digitalized electronic invoice carries a unique tax control code and anti-counterfeiting QR code, and invoice data is uploaded in real time to the STA Golden Tax system. Special VAT invoices are transmitted to the national VAT invoice verification and cross-matching platform in real time, enabling automatic matching of input VAT credits and export declarations. Taxpayers use the e-Tax Bureau's online invoice issuance functions and API-based interfaces; no manual cash register invoice is accepted for a WFOE required to issue Special VAT Invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A WFOE may claim 0% VAT for the export of used construction excavators only if: (1) the goods are physically exported from mainland China customs territory under a Customs release; (2) the export transaction is supported by a valid Export Goods Customs Declaration; (3) the WFOE is the supplier and receives the export sales consideration in foreign exchange through a designated bank; (4) the proceeds are repatriated within the statutory period; and (5) the input VAT on the purchase of the used machinery is substantiated by VAT Special Invoices or customs import VAT payment documents. The particular export commodity classification must fall within the applicable export zero-rating/tax rebate coverage and must not be subject to export prohibition. Exports that fail these conditions, including exports to bonded zones without actual customs departure or transactions with uncollected foreign exchange, are not zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Goods Customs Declaration Form (customs export declaration with electronic release message)
Bill of Lading (or equivalent multimodal, airway, or railway transport document evidencing physical export)
Export Sales Contract or Purchase Order
Bank Foreign Exchange Receipt Voucher / Export Proceeds Collection Confirmation (bank-confirmed inward remittance certificate)
VAT Special Invoice(s) for the domestic purchase of the used excavators, or the Customs Import VAT Payment Certificate if previously imported, to substantiate the input VAT refund
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA and China Customs cross-match export declarations, Special VAT Invoice data, logistics records, and foreign exchange receipts. If the 180-day FX repatriation deadline is missed, or if documentation is false, incomplete, or inconsistent, the tax authority will disallow the 0% rate, require output VAT at the applicable rate, recover any refunded/offset input VAT, and impose late payment surcharge (0.05% per day on overdue tax). Under the Law on Administration of Tax Collection, deliberate false export zero-rating may attract a fine of 50% to 5 times the tax underpaid, suspension or cancellation of export tax rebate qualification, downgrade of taxpayer credit rating, and criminal referral for fraudulently obtaining export tax rebates. The clawback is retrospective to the original refund/credit period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC) for the mainland China WFOE, with Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) supervising the Hong Kong clearing node as a fully convertible offshored liquidity layer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The mainland-resident WFOE operates under SAFE's bifurcated currency regime. Current-account transactions are convertible in principle after banks perform real-transaction verification through the Goods Trade and Service Trade monitoring systems; every payment or receipt must reference an authentic contract, invoice, customs declaration, or service receipt. Capital-account transactions are not freely convertible. Inbound FDI equity injections require a SAFE FDI registration, a designated capital-foreign-exchange account, and use that conforms to the Foreign Investment Negative List and the registered business scope. Capital proceeds cannot be diverted into unapproved wealth management, real estate, securities, or related-party lending. Profit remittance to the Hong Kong shareholder is treated as a current-account outward remittance only after the WFOE completes its annual statutory audit and final corporate income tax settlement; the bank will demand the audited statements, the shareholders' dividend resolution, tax filing certificates, and beneficial-ownership declarations. If the Hong Kong shareholder is a qualifying beneficial owner of more than 25 percent, the China-Hong Kong double tax arrangement supports a 5 percent dividend withholding rate rather than the usual 10 percent, subject to a Hong Kong Tax Residency Certificate and treaty-benefit analysis. The WFOE must repatriate all export proceeds to a domestic bank rather than leaving them on an offshore payment platform; retention in foreign currency is permissible, but no fixed percentage must be sold, and the receipt must be declared under the goods-trade monitoring framework. The Hong Kong jurisdiction itself has no exchange controls, but the WFOE cannot use Hong Kong as a bypass around onshore capital restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the PRC Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Administration, export proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic bank and entered into the Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Account or settled into RMB. The standard SAFE administration deadline is the 90-day collection period from the date of the Customs export declaration; if proceeds are not credited by that point, a trade-data discrepancy report is mandatory. There is no fixed mandatory conversion ratio: 100 percent must be repatriated, but 0-100 percent can be held in foreign currency or sold to the bank at market rate, so the true surrender obligation is full physical repatriation and prompt reporting rather than a quota-based conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for FDI registered capital plus RMB basic operational account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Settlement Account and CNY operating account
Basic operational currency account and cross-border trade disbursement account
Working capital and FX hedging collateral account with offshore connectivity
Multi-currency corporate account and cross-border liquidity clearing account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: LOW / NOT AUTHORISED for primary onshore banking. Offshore digital EMIs do not hold a PBOC payment institution license sufficient to operate the SAFE goods-trade monitoring and capital-account settlement window for a China-resident WFOE. The WFOE must use a licensed bank for export receipt repatriation, capital injection settlement, and dividend remittance. An HK-licensed EMI can function only as an ancillary collection or payout utility for the Hong Kong treasury node, never as the final channel for onshore RMB clearings; all onshore CNY obligations and export proceeds must move through CNAPS, CIPS, or SAFE-monitored banking rails. The EMT relationship therefore cannot replace a statutory Tier-1 commercial bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: SAFE-regulated banks generally require the WFOE statutory legal representative to appear physically at the bank branch for a KYC interview before account activation. Remote video verification can be accepted by some Tier-1 banks when the legal representative is abroad, but only after documentary due diligence is complete and the passport or government ID image is matched; a pure consular-notarized proxy opening without the legal representative completing either a physical or live video interview is not accepted for a Medium-Risk Enhanced used-machinery WFOE. Where a proxy is used, the bank requires a notarized and legalized power of attorney, the original articles of association, board or shareholders' resolution, and a certified copy of the legal representative's passport, plus completion of a subsequent remote interview or sub-branch appearance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Over- and under-invoicing of secondhand excavators with no independent value benchmark; invoices inconsistent with auction prices, refurbishment condition, or scrappage value.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full purchase and sales chain documentation, OEM VIN and engine serial number inventory, independent condition survey and valuation report from a certified heavy-machinery appraiser, pre-shipment inspection certificate, Customs import and export declarations, transport contracts, insurance certificate, and bank payment evidence matching the invoice value.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity and shell-company formation around the Hong Kong shareholder; nominee directors, bearer-like arrangements, or lack of substantive economic activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Hong Kong Companies Registry records, certificate of incorporation, shareholder register, director register, annual return, accounting records and audited financial statements, HKMA-satisfactory beneficial ownership declaration down to ultimate natural persons, source-of-wealth statement for each UBO, tax-residence certificates, and board resolutions authorizing the WFOE capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, export-control, and diversion risk for reconditioned earthmovers, especially any onward channel to embargoed regions, restricted end-users, or military-related application.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-user certificate and end-use statement, dealer and end-buyer KYC files, denial-list screening reports from UN, OFAC, EU, China MOFCOM, and HK Trade and Industry Department, strategic commodities classification opinion, logistics itinerary with port and waybill evidence, customs broker confirmations, and an anti-diversion warranty from the buyer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Funds opacity in capital injection and trade payments; HK funds sourced from unrelated third parties, cryptocurrencies, unlicensed money services, or loop structures, or SWIFT remitter not matching the registered shareholder name.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of bank statements and loan agreements for the HK treasury entity, source-of-wealth files for shareholders, formal intercompany loan agreements and SAFE external-debt filings if applicable, an undertaking that no crypto or unlicensed MSO rails were used, plus a payment-matching report ledger reconciling SWIFT MT103s with invoices and Customs declarations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 routed from the HK shareholder's account at a licensed bank to the WFOE's SAFE-registered Capital-Foreign-Exchange Account at an onshore Tier-1 bank. The remitter must exactly match the registered shareholder and the SAFE FDI registration confirmation must be produced before crediting. The message should carry the bank's international balance-of-payments declaration category for inbound direct-investment equity capital and an explicit narrative such as WFOE registered capital injection under SAFE FDI registration number XXXX; no goods invoice or secondhand-machinery import code should be used for an equity wire. The onshore bank will post the credit to the capital-foreign-exchange account, validate the business against the Foreign Investment Negative List, settle permitted amounts to RMB for operating expenses, and the WFOE's PRC certified public accountant will issue a capital verification report to update the corporate capital ledger. For the HK intermediate treasury layer, the HKMA licensed bank may also require a board borrowing resolution and source-of-funds pack before releasing the transfer.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For payments to overseas suppliers of used construction machinery and implements, the WFOE should use a clean SWIFT MT103 for low-value open-account disbursements, an irrevocable documentary letter of credit with MT700 structure for high-value imported earthmovers, and documentary collections using D/P or D/A when there is an established trade relationship. Every MT103 must include the underlying goods-import payment declaration reference and the Trade in Goods monitoring code; the bank should be given the commercial invoice, packing list, transport document, insurance certificate, auction or remarketing award if any, and condition survey. Where the beneficiary is a Hong Kong seller and settlement is in CNH, the payment can clear through CIPS; where settlement is in USD or EUR, the transfer moves through the commercial bank's nostro and Vostro clearing rails. The WFOE must retain all Customs Import Declarations and condition reports in the bank transaction file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CNY/USD and CNY/EUR outright forwards and swaps with a licensed PRC bank on real-demand background, with trade or capital exposure documentation and no net-open-position speculation.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps for long-term approved external borrowings or FDI term liabilities after SAFE external-debt registration, with notional and tenor aligned to the underlying obligation.

Hong Kong offshore CNH forwards and NDFs are permissible for the HK treasury and clearing vehicle with genuine CNH receipts; they are not permissible onshore for the WFOE as standalone speculative instruments, and the boundaries must prevent offshore NDFs from acting as an unlicensed capital-account conversion channel.

Structured forwards with zero-cost collar or knock-in and knock-out features are permissible only where the embedded options are supported by the same real-demand underlying trade and are executed through a licensed commercial bank, not through unregulated digital derivative platforms.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form NAR1) for a private company limited by shares
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies Registry, The Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after each anniversary of incorporation; the made-up date is the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fees escalate from HKD 600 (overdue up to 3 months) to HKD 4,800 (overdue more than 12 months); company and every responsible person may be prosecuted with a fine of up to HKD 50,000 and a daily default fine of HKD 1,000; repeated default supports the Registrar's power to strike off a defunct company under Companies Ordinance Cap. 622 s.746.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the Business Registration Certificate (Business Registration Fee and Levy)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office, Inland Revenue Department, Hong Kong
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before the expiry of the current one-year Business Registration Certificate; renewal notices are issued by IRD and a late penalty is incurred after the expiry grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late renewal penalty of HKD 300 applies; carrying on business without a valid certificate can result in a fine of up to HKD 5,000 and imprisonment for up to 6 months and, for continued contravention, daily defaults; persistent non-renewal is treated as evidence that the company is not carrying on business for Companies Registry strike-off purposes.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profits Tax Return (Form BIR51) together with audited financial statements, tax computation and supporting schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of the IRD issue date of the return; tax representatives can apply for extension, and for accounting periods ending 31 December the extended filing window is generally around August of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file without reasonable excuse is an offence with a fine of HKD 10,000; IRD may issue estimated assessments under s.59(3) and may apply penalties up to 300% of any tax undercharged after court assessment; no automatic company strike-off, but persistent non-compliance may lead to enforcement action and Comptroller's judgment debt enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Employer's Return of remuneration and pensions (Forms BIR56A/BIR56B)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of the IRD issue date; annual cycle begins in April after the year of assessment ending 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or nil failure without reasonable excuse can result in a fine of up to HKD 10,000 and imprisonment up to 6 months; IRD may estimate employer remuneration and issue assessed demands; non-compliance does not by itself trigger strike-off, but an active BIR56 exposure is a company-compliance flag.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting, circulation and laying of audited financial statements, director's report and auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders in general meeting; minutes and resolutions retained in the corporate records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Private company must hold its AGM within 9 months of the end of each accounting reference period; financial statements must be circulated at least 21 days before the AGM
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Offence with a fine of up to HKD 50,000 and daily default fine of HKD 1,000 for responsible persons; failure to hold the AGM and lay audited accounts undermines the accuracy of Annual Return confirmations and can trigger an inspection leading to strike-off if the company is considered defunct.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Significant Controllers Register update and on-site availability confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Maintained at the registered office or another prescribed place in Hong Kong; inspected by the Companies Registry and law enforcement agencies, no filing to a public registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Update within 7 days of any change in significant controllers; confirm no-change status alongside the annual return and following any share transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is a strict-liability offence carrying a level-4 fine of HKD 25,000 and a daily default fine of HKD 700 on continuing breach for the company and each responsible officer; repeated SCR failures create regulatory-distress evidence that may support investigation and ultimate strike-off under the Companies Ordinance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Hong Kong imposes no balance-sheet, turnover or headcount exemptions; every non-dormant company incorporated under Companies Ordinance Cap. 622 must be audited each year by an independent practicing Certified Public Accountant. The only legal dispensation is the dormant-company audit exemption, available when the company has no significant accounting transactions in the relevant period and the members approve the dispensation. All non-dormant private companies must prepare annual financial statements under CO s.379 and obtain an auditor's report under CO s.405.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS) as issued by the Hong Kong Institute of CPAs, fully aligned with IFRS; eligible small-to-medium private enterprises may apply the elective HKFRS for Private Entities (HKFRS-PE), subject to fulfillment of legal size criteria and true-and-fair presentation under Companies Ordinance Cap. 622; statutory records and evidence retention follow Inland Revenue Ordinance Cap.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard PRC resident corporate income tax rate; 10% is the statutory non-resident withholding rate on China-source passive income such as dividends, interest and royalties under Articles 3 and 37 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No free-zone tax holiday, patent box, or special preferential rate is assumed for the wholesale remarketing of used construction excavators under ISIC 4659/NAICS 423810. A qualifying High and New Technology Enterprise may access 15%, and a qualifying small and low-profit enterprise with annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million, employee headcount not exceeding 300, and total assets not exceeding RMB 50 million may effectively pay 5% on the first RMB 3 million of profit. The R&D super-deduction of 100% is available only for qualifying R&D entities and does not apply to a pure trading/remarketing WFOE.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC State Taxation Administration Form A100000 (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return, A-Class) together with supporting schedules A105000 (tax adjustment items), A106000 (loss carryforward), A107010/A107012 (if claiming tax incentive or R&D deductions), and the annual related-party transaction disclosure statement; filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax portal) and local competent tax authority online filing system
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement return with quarterly provisional prepayment returns during the tax year
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual CIT settlement and filing must be completed within 5 months after the end of the tax year, i.e. by 31 May for a calendar-year taxpayer; quarterly provisional CIT returns and prepayments are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the tax year is the calendar year unless otherwise approved by the tax authority

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sales revenue (operating revenue from wholesale sales of used hydraulic earthmovers and rollers)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize all gross proceeds from the remarketing of used excavators, rollers, and related machinery on an accrual basis. For a Hong Kong-owned WFOE, any sale to the HK parent or another related party must be recorded at the arm's length price; artificial selling-price discounts that shift profit to Hong Kong will be adjusted under Article 41 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and may trigger Article 63 tax evasion penalties if accompanied by false records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating cost (cost of purchased used machinery, refurbishment parts, freight, customs duties and import handling)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct cost of sales only with complete documentation: purchase contracts, customs declarations, VAT special invoices, bank payment proof and inventory records. A WFOE that overpays a HK related supplier for used equipment without delivery, inspection, or business substance creates a transfer pricing adjustment and potential criminal false-invoice exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes and surcharges (taxes deductible for CIT other than CIT itself and VAT itself)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include stamp duty, property tax, land use tax, and urban maintenance and construction surcharges. CIT is not deductible; VAT is not deductible in the CIT return; dividend withholding tax borne by the WFOE on behalf of the HK shareholder is not deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses (commissions, advertising, overseas marketing, transportation and exhibition costs)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A commission or marketing fee paid to a Hong Kong agent is deductible only if the agent performed real commercial services, the fee is at arm's length, the service is not an internal profit distribution, and the WFOE possesses service agreements, invoices, workpapers and evidence of benefit. Pure profit-stripping through fake commissions is a serious red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses (management salaries, rent, professional fees, intercompany management charges)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany management fees paid to the HK parent are deductible only if genuine services were rendered, the services actually benefited the WFOE, the fee is arm's length, and contemporaneous documentation is retained. Payments labelled as management fees but lacking substance may be recharacterized as disguised dividends, triggering withholding tax and penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial expenses (interest expense, bank charges, exchange losses, arrangement fees)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to the HK shareholder on intercompany debt is deductible only if the rate is at arm's length and the debt is within the thin-capitalisation limits under Article 46 of the EIT Law and Cai Shui [2008] No. 121: 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio for non-financial enterprises. Excess interest is non-deductible and may be treated as a dividend distribution subject to 10% withholding tax or 5% treaty rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment income (interest, dividends, gains from equity investments)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received by the WFOE from a Chinese resident subsidiary are generally exempt from CIT if the shareholding conditions are met, while dividends paid by the WFOE to the HK parent are after-tax profit appropriations and are not deductible. The WFOE must ensure that the financial statements do not classify a dividend as an expense.

The total accounting profit must reconcile with the audited statutory financial statements and the income-summary schedules. Cross-border recharges, unrealized profits in inventory purchased from HK, and provisions must be fully reviewed before the CIT reconciliation is prepared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income adjustments (tax-exempt income, non-deductible items, loss carryforward, and other differences)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use Schedule A105000 to add back non-deductible administration fees, excessive entertainment expenses, fines, tax penalties, and interest above the thin-capitalisation limit; deduct allowable loss carryforwards limited to 5 years. Losses of the WFOE cannot be transferred to the HK shareholder; the HK shareholder cannot shelter its own income with the Chinese subsidiary's losses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable calculation (25% CIT, tax credits, and total tax payable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 25% to taxable income to compute the CIT payable and claim any lawful foreign tax credit for foreign-source income. This CIT return does not compute non-resident dividend withholding tax; instead, when the WFOE distributes profit to the HK parent, the WFOE must act as withholding agent, withhold 10% (or 5% if the China-HK DTA beneficial-owner conditions are satisfied), and file a separate withholding tax return with the competent Chinese tax authority.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual CIT return exposes the WFOE to a fine of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 under Article 62 of the Law on the Administration of Tax Levying and Collection, rising to RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000 for serious cases. Late payment of tax attracts a daily surcharge of 0.05% on the underpaid amount. Under Article 63, tax evasion through false returns, concealment of sales, or false invoices results in recovery of the underpaid tax and a fine of 50% to 500% of the underpaid amount. Criminal tax evasion under Article 201 of the Criminal Law can lead to imprisonment for up to 3 years for relatively large evasion amounts and 3 to 7 years for huge amounts; issuance or use of false special VAT invoices under Article 205 can lead to imprisonment up to life imprisonment for especially large amounts. The legal representative can also be listed as a seriously untrustworthy taxpayer and prohibited from exiting China.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory Chinese withholding tax on outbound dividends paid by the WFOE to its non-resident shareholder; reduced to 5% under the China-Hong Kong Double Taxation Arrangement (DTA) where the beneficial owner of the dividend is a Hong Kong company that holds directly at least 25% of the capital of the Chinese paying company
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke the 5% DTA dividend rate, the Hong Kong shareholder must obtain a Hong Kong Tax Residency Certificate from the Inland Revenue Department for the relevant tax year, prove beneficial ownership of the dividend with constitutional documents, board minutes, audited financial statements, employee and premises records, and evidence that it is not a conduit company
